name: responsivejs.com
description: What this site promises about itself. Verified in CI by rjs — the badge in the footer is this file passing.

rules.description: nothing bleeds out of the viewport at any width — code blocks scroll on purpose and are reported as warnings, not errors
every visible link meets the WCAG 2.5.8 (AA) 24px floor; links flowing inside prose are exempt by the standard
the same floor for controls — the theme switch failed this at 768px until we measured it
body text meets WCAG AA against the background actually painted behind it
inline code too — its chip is semi-transparent, so the check composites it over what is behind
the hero headline never shrinks as the viewport grows — the class of bug a per-width screenshot review cannot see
and it grows smoothly: no jump larger than its whole declared range between adjacent widths
the page actually renders content at every width (a blank page passes every other rule)
